item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[バンコク ２日 ロイター] - タイ国際航空のチャイ・エアムシリ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２日、先週バンコクを襲った大規模な洪水への対応が混乱したことを受けて、取締役会に解任されたと明らかにした。

• エアムシリ氏は同日開かれた取締役会について記者団に「理由は示されなかった」と説明。その上で「取締役会は危機対応における不備や問題点を精査したいと考えているようだ」と述べた。

• 一方、タイ国際航空は２日夜、証券取引所への提出資料で、事実関係の調査と危機管理手順の見直しが完了するまでエアムシリ氏を職務停止とし、サムリット・サムニアン取締役をＣＥＯ代行に任命したと発表した。

• タイ国際航空は今週、数十便の欠航と貨物業務の停止を余儀なくされた。洪水の影響で従業員が出勤できなくなったことなどが原因だった。

• スワンナプーム空港では、手荷物の引き渡しに大幅な遅れが生じ、滞留の解消に空軍の支援が必要になるなど、業務が混乱した。

• バンコクでは３日間の降水量が３２０ミリと、例年の９月１カ月分に相当する水準に達し、被災地域に指定された。

• スラサック観光相は９月２９日、タイ国際航空を名指しで批判。「仕事をする気がないなら辞任すべきだ」と述べた。

item.title: Curazao y Haití clasifican a cuartos de final en Liga de Naciones Concacaf
item.description: Las selecciones de fútbol de Curazao y Haití aseguraron el domingo su lugar en los cuartos de final de la Liga de Naciones de la Concacaf a pesar de empatar y perder sus respectivos compromisos en la cuarta y última jornada de la fase de grupos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las selecciones de fútbol de Curazao y Haití aseguraron el domingo su lugar en los cuartos de final de la Liga de Naciones de la Concacaf a pesar de empatar y perder sus respectivos compromisos en la cuarta y última jornada de la fase de grupos. Curazao empató por 1-1 ante Trinidad y Tobago, mientras que Haití perdió por 2-1 en su visita a Costa Rica, que evitó descender a la Liga B al registrar dos triunfos consecutivos tras haber iniciado el torneo con dos derrotas. En tanto, Trinidad y Tobago y Nicaragua descendieron a la Liga B del torneo al finalizar la fase de grupos en el quinto y sexto lugar de su sector. Curazao finalizó como líder del grupo con 10 puntos, uno más que Haití y República Dominicana. La selección haitiana clasificó a la siguiente fase debido a que registró una mejor diferencia de goles. El sector lo completaron Costa Rica con seis unidades, Trinidad y Tobago con una y Nicaragua, que no sumó. Los dos primeros lugares de cada uno de los dos grupos pasan a los cuartos de final, donde se unirán a las selecciones de México, Estados Unidos, Canadá y Panamá, que llegaron directamente a esa instancia por ser las mejores clasificadas de la Concacaf. Los ganadores de la fase de los cuartos de final clasificarán directamente a la Copa Oro del 2027. “Empieza una nueva era para los países del Caribe, lo que aumenta el nivel de la Concacaf”, dijo el director técnico de Haití, el español David Badía. En el partido disputado en el estadio Hasely Crawford de Puerto España, Trinidad y Tobago se puso en ventaja a los 39 minutos cuando Luke Phillips definió de derecha en el área tras recibir un pase de Wayne Frederick en una jugada que inició con un saque de banda. Curazao empató a los 61 minutos por conducto de Jordi Paulina, quien remató barriéndose en el área chica tras un centro enviado por Juninho Bacuna desde el sector derecho. En tanto, en el estadio Ricardo Saprissa, en San José, Costa Rica ganó por 2-0 a Haití gracias a los goles de Carlos Mora y Andrey Soto. Un triunfo que no le alcanzó para pasar a los cuartos de final, pero sí para mantenerse en la Liga A y acceder a un repechaje para buscar un cupo en la Copa Oro 2027. El dominio de la selección local se reflejó a los seis minutos con un remate de cabeza de Mora tras un tiro de esquina enviado desde el sector izquierdo por Ronald Matarrita, quien dio el pase que Soto controló en el área para vencer al portero Josué Duverger con un potente disparo cruzado de zurda a los 21 minutos. Costa Rica siguió controlando el partido, pero no fue suficiente para complacer de nuevo a los miles de aficionados que llegaron a apoyar a pesar de la lluvia. "Estoy muy contento por las dos victorias, de mi parte la tarea está cumplida y en adelante veremos qué pasa. Estos dos partidos dejan la semilla sembrada para que el entrenador que venga la haga crecer", dijo Bryan Ruiz, quien el lunes fue designado director técnico interino tras la destitución del argentino Fernando "Bocha" Batista. Se espera que en los próximos días, la Federación Costarricense de Fútbol (FCRF) informe su decisión respecto al técnico de la selección. Por su parte, en el estadio Nacional de Managua, República Dominicana remontó un gol y venció por 2-1 en su visita a Nicaragua, que se puso en ventaja a los 53 minutos cuando Jaime Moreno remató en el área chica un tiro de esquina enviado por Widman Talavera desde el sector derecho. República Dominicana empató a los 58 minutos con un tiro penal que anotó Heinz Mörschel después de que el defensa Justing Cano lo derribó dentro del área, y dio la vuelta al marcador a los 66 con un potente disparo de volea de Lucas Breton desde fuera del área después de que el portero Brandon Mayorga rechazó un tiro de esquina enviado desde el sector derecho. La fase de grupos del torneo finalizará el lunes cuando El Salvador visite a Martinica, Guatemala sea local ante Surinam y Honduras juegue ante Jamaica en la última jornada del sector B que lidera Surinam con siete puntos, seguido por Jamaica con seis y Guatemala con cuatro. Más abajo se ubican Honduras, Martinica y El Salvador con tres unidades cada uno. La Liga de Naciones es una competencia lanzada por la Concacaf en 2018 para garantizar que las 41 Asociaciones Miembro del organismo que rige el fútbol en Norteamérica, Centroamérica y El Caribe compitan regularmente en partidos oficiales entre las Copas del Mundo. Estados Unidos la ganó en 2021, 2023 y 2024. México logró el título en 2025.

item.title: Golden Knights continue dominance of Canucks with 3-goal second period
item.description: Marc Gatcomb scored the go-ahead goal late in the second period and Adin Hill made 18 saves to lead the visiting Vegas Golden Knights to a 3-2 victory over the Vancouver Canucks on Sunday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Marc Gatcomb scored the go-ahead goal late in the second period and Adin Hill made 18 saves to lead the visiting Vegas Golden Knights to a 3-2 victory over the Vancouver Canucks on Sunday night. Mitch Marner and Victor Olofsson also scored goals for Vegas, which improved to 22-4-3 all-time against the Canucks. It was the eighth consecutive win over the Canucks for the Golden Knights since a 4-3 loss on April 8, 2024. Hill, making his first start for Vegas since April 9 of last season, extended his personal win streak against Vancouver to five straight games. Paul Cotter and Jonathan Lekkerimaki scored goals for Vancouver, which was playing the second game of a back-to-back that began with a 4-1 home victory over Calgary on Saturday. Kevin Lankinen stopped 25 of 28 shots for the Canucks on Sunday. Vancouver took a 1-0 lead at the 18:52 mark of the first period on a power-play goal by Cotter, who redirected a seam pass from Filip Hronek from the left point inside the right post for his team-leading fourth goal. Vegas tied it midway through the second period on Marner's wrist shot from the slot into the top left corner. It was the first goal of the season for Marner, who was the top scorer in the Stanley Cup playoffs last spring with 29 points in 22 games. The Golden Knights then took a 2-1 lead on a power-play goal by Olofsson, who roofed in a rebound of a Mark Stone shot from the bottom of the right circle. The Canucks tied it at the 17:54 mark on a sharp-angle shot by Lekkerimaki from the bottom of the right circle past Hill's blocker side. Vegas regained the advantage 34 seconds later when Gatcomb jammed in a cross-crease pass from Braeden Bowman inside the right post for what proved to be the game-winner. Vancouver pulled Lankinen for an extra attacker with 2:15 remaining and Hronek blocked Jack Eichel's shot at an empty net that would have sealed it a few seconds later. The Canucks, outshot 28-20 in the contest, had one good scoring chance, a shot by Elias Pettersson from the bottom of the left circle with 2 seconds left that hit the left post. --Field Level Media

item.title: USA-Une résidente de Californie accusée d'espionner pour la Chine un fils du président taïwanais
item.description: Les autorités américaines ont arrêté dimanche une résidente de Californie accusée d'opérer comme agent étranger clandestin et d'espionner l'un des fils du président taïwanais Lai Ching-te à la demande de responsables chinois, a déclaré le FBI.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Les autorités américaines ont arrêté dimanche une résidente de Californie accusée d'opérer comme agent étranger clandestin et d'espionner l'un des fils du président taïwanais Lai Ching-te à la demande de responsables chinois, a déclaré le FBI. Cette arrestation a été effectuée à l'aéroport international de Los Angeles alors que la suspecte, Wanying Zhang, également connue sous le nom de Heather et âgée de 34 ans, s'apprêtait à partir en Chine, a indiqué l'agence fédérale dans un communiqué. Wanying Zhang espionnait l'un des fils de Lai Ching-te, a déclaré le FBI, sans préciser directement le nom de celui-ci, avant de relayer un article du New York Post identifiant la cible de Zhang comme étant Lai Ting-yu, résident américain. A Taipei, les services de la présidence taïwanaise ont décrit les agissements de Wanying Zhang comme un "cas typique de répression transnationale" et ont remercié le gouvernement américain de protéger les citoyens taïwanais. Aucun commentaire n'a été obtenu dans l'immédiat auprès du ministère chinois des Affaires étrangères. D'après le département américain de la Justice, Wanying Zhang s'est rendue l'an dernier à Seattle à la demande de responsables chinois auxquels elle a envoyé des photos et une vidéo de Lai Ting-yu et de sa famille ainsi que le numéro de plaque d'immatriculation de son véhicule. Lai Ching-te défend la souveraineté de Taïwan et de sa population, une position qui déplaît à la Chine, laquelle considère l'île démocratique comme une province renégate qu'elle entend ramener dans son giron, sans exclure d'utiliser la force. Washington n'a pas de liens diplomatiques formels avec Taipei mais est le principal fournisseur d'armes et soutien de l'île.

item.title: Blues F Alexey Toropchenko (upper-body injury) out at least 6 weeks
item.description: St. Louis Blues forward Alexey Toropchenko will miss at least six weeks because of an upper-body injury, the team announced on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: St. Louis Blues forward Alexey Toropchenko will miss at least six weeks because of an upper-body injury, the team announced on Sunday. Toropchenko, 27, sustained an apparent right shoulder injury in the season opener, a 4-0 win at the Dallas Stars on Friday. He was behind the net when he was hit by Stars defenseman Lian Bichsel and then forward Tyler Seguin with 16:32 remaining in the second period. He did not return to the game and finished with eight shifts for 5:08 of ice time. Toropchenko sat out a 6-1 defeat to the host Colorado Avalanche on Saturday. The Blues said he will be re-evaluated in six weeks. For his career, Toropchenko has 71 points (34 goals, 37 assists), a minus-18 rating, 110 penalty minutes, 231 blocks and 712 hits in 325 regular-season games since the 2021-22 season. He also has two goals, four assists, a plus-9 rating, 12 penalty minutes, eight blocks and 50 hits in 19 playoff games. St. Louis selected Toropchenko in the fourth round of the 2017 NHL Draft. --Field Level Media

item.title: Former Prince Andrew takes police to court over Epstein files arrest, Telegraph says
item.description: King Charles' younger brother, Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor, has launched a legal action against Thames Valley Police over his arrest for suspicion of misconduct in office based on documents released by the US Justice Department on the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, the Telegraph reported on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: King Charles' younger brother, Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor, has launched a legal action against Thames Valley Police over his arrest for suspicion of misconduct in office based on documents released by the US Justice Department on the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, the Telegraph reported on Sunday. Mountbatten-Windsor, who was [USN:L8N42C1GE TEXT:"arrested"] in February on suspicion of leaking government documents to Epstein when he was a special representative for trade between 2001 and 2011, has asked a judge to determine whether the police force’s action towards him was lawful, the report said. Reuters could not immediately verify the report. Thames Valley Police and Buckingham Palace did not immediately respond to an emailed request for comment, sent outside regular business hours. Mountbatten-Windsor, the second son of the late Queen Elizabeth, has denied any wrongdoing in relation to Epstein, and said he regrets their friendship. According to the Telegraph, he has lodged a judicial review in connection with the search warrants that allowed police to raid his home on the Sandringham Estate and his former residence at Royal Lodge in Windsor. Mountbatten-Windsor was [USN:L8N3ZF0RK TEXT:"questioned all day"] by detectives from Thames Valley Police after being detained. The police force said it was looking into allegations that he had passed documents to Epstein while working as the trade envoy. The former prince was forced to quit all official royal duties in 2019 over his ties with Epstein and was then stripped by his older brother of his titles and honours last October amid further revelations about their relationship.

item.title: IMF, Sri Lanka strike staff-level pact on funding of $345 million
item.description: The International Monetary Fund said it reached a staff-level agreement with Sri Lanka on the seventh review under its Extended Fund Facility to unlock financing of about $345 million.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The International Monetary Fund said it reached a staff-level agreement with Sri Lanka on the seventh review under its Extended Fund Facility to unlock financing of about $345 million. The island nation, backed by a $2.9-billion programme, is clawing its way out of a 2022 economic upheaval triggered by a severe shortage of dollars The staff-level deal needs approval from the IMF executive board and hinges on the 2027 budget to be unveiled next month in parliament, in line with programme provisions and completion of a review of financing assurances The review will confirm multilateral partners’ financing contributions and assess if debt restructuring is adequate, the global lender said in Sunday's statement Upon completion of the review, Sri Lanka will have access to the IMF's special drawing rights equivalent to about $345 million, taking the lender's total disbursed funds to the equivalent of $2.7 billion, it added In May, the IMF forecast 3% growth this year for Sri Lanka as it approved a $700-million double tranche under the programme, to bolster reserves Sri Lanka, which imports all its fuel, faces downside risks from uncertainty over the Middle East war, global trade, and the impact of the El Niño weather phenomenon, the IMF said It urged the government to let domestic fuel prices adjust in line with international rates while protecting the vulnerable.

item.title: Smoky Singapore gears up to talk money ahead of F1
item.description: Regional, business, cryptocurrency and sports leaders are meeting in Singapore for a slew of finance-focused conferences ahead of this weekend's Grand Prix as haze continues to shroud the city-state.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Regional, business, cryptocurrency and sports leaders are meeting in Singapore for a slew of finance-focused conferences ahead of this weekend's Grand Prix as haze continues to shroud the city-state. Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr, famed investor Ray Dalio and Eric Trump, co-founder of the family-backed cryptocurrency business, are expected, while hundreds of thousands of Formula 1 fans will converge on the island. The night race through the city streets and some 40 sideline events are typically a global showcase for Singapore and hotel room rates have soared. The Fullerton Bay Hotel next to the race track is charging S$5,030 ($3,933) a night for a room that typically costs $1,460. This year the pall from Indonesia's most [USN:L6N4580KB TEXT:"intense fires"] in more than a decade will probably form part of the backdrop. Air quality was forecast at the "high moderate to low unhealthy" range on Monday by Singapore's environment agency. No longer-range forecast was provided for Sunday's Grand Prix. Singapore's tourism board said F1 and its surrounding events had "strong momentum" reflecting confidence despite economic and geopolitical uncertainty. Jitters in financial markets where [USN:L1N45N082 TEXT:"bond prices are slumping"] and sentiment around on AI is [USN:L6N45H0SG TEXT:"shifting"] from euphoric to cautious will occupy investors and business chiefs at the Forbes CEO Conference and Milken Asia Summit, which runs from Wednesday. Trump, a co-founder of crypto venture World Liberty Financial, is due to speak at the TOKEN2049 cryptocurrency event with digital asset markets fragile following a bruising 12 months. [USN:L1N4580IW TEXT:"A hoped-for regulatory framework"] failed last month to clear the US Senate, in part as President Donald Trump's personal crypto dealings became a flashpoint for Democrats. Despite a recent bounce, the total value of the cryptocurrency market is down about a quarter over the last 12 months to $3 trillion, according to data aggregator CoinGecko. Still, organisers say their event is nearly sold out with 25,000 attendees expected, the [USN:L2N3VJ09M TEXT:"same as last year"]. The Straits Times reported that about 90,000 "c-suite," or top ranking, executives will be in town. F1 generates around S$145 million in incremental tourism receipts for Singapore each year, according to official estimates. Maybank economist Chua Hak Bin expects it to hit S$160 million this year, along with "wider economic benefits" from deals struck at sideline events. ($1 = 1.2794 Singapore dollars)

item.title: India's HDFC Bank rises after CEO appointment
item.description: Shares of India's HDFC Bank rose as much as 1.8% on Monday, as investors welcomed the appointment of Anup Bagchi as CEO, the first external candidate to lead the country's biggest private lender, ending weeks of uncertainty regarding leadership.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Shares of India's HDFC Bank (HDBK.NS) rose as much as 1.8% on Monday, as investors welcomed the [USN:L1N45N0IO TEXT:"appointment"] of Anup Bagchi as CEO, the first external candidate to lead the country's biggest private lender, ending weeks of uncertainty regarding leadership. Bagchi succeeds Sashidhar Jagdishan, who decided in August not to seek reappointment after his second three-year term ends on October 26. Shares were trading about 1% higher at 728.6 rupees as of 9:37 a.m. IST. Bagchi, currently CEO at ICICI Prudential Life Insurance, previously held senior roles at ICICI Bank (ICBK.NS) , the country's second-biggest private lender, where he oversaw its retail and wholesale banking businesses. He also led ICICI Securities for six years. Brokerages said the appointment is expected to serve HDFC well. It allows the bank to optimise its operating structure and leadership team to better achieve growth, profitability and governance objectives, said Jefferies. A key overhang surrounding the bank's leadership has been removed, noted Motilal Oswal, adding that Bagchi brought an external perspective at a time when the firm is seeking to rebuild investor confidence. His experience across retail and wholesale banking, digital financial services, capital markets, wealth management and insurance will be an asset across HDFC's BFSI segments, the brokerage added. Emkay Global said stability in upper management, reviving deposit growth and improving productivity of newer branches would be key priorities for the incoming CEO. Jagdishan, who succeeded Aditya Puri as HDFC Bank CEO, had been expected to remain in the role despite having less than three years before reaching the regulatory tenure limit. His departure follows Chairman Atanu Chakraborty's abrupt March resignation over governance concerns that an independent legal review did not substantiate. The bank on Saturday posted a jump of around 18.8% in its deposits and a 16.3% rise in its gross advances as of September end.

item.title: Bryce Young, Tetairoa McMillan’s connection leads Panthers past Lions
item.description: Carolina's Bryce Young threw two touchdown passes to Tetairoa McMillan and the injury-riddled Panthers defense limited the Detroit Lions to two touchdowns in a 32-26 victory Sunday night in Charlotte.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Carolina's Bryce Young threw two touchdown passes to Tetairoa McMillan and the injury-riddled Panthers defense limited the Detroit Lions to two touchdowns in a 32-26 victory Sunday night in Charlotte. Chuba Hubbard racked up 122 rushing yards and a pair of touchdowns as the Panthers (2-2) won at home for the first time in two tries this season. Young completed 29 of 41 passes for 329 yards. McMillan's 14 receptions accounted for 192 yards. Hubbard had 20 carries. Jared Goff was 32-for-52 passing for 412 yards and one touchdown for the Lions (2-2). Jameson Williams made six receptions for 102 yards. Jake Bates kicked field goals from 54, 43, 41 and 26 yards. Detroit didn't attempt to produce much of a ground attack as only 15 of its 68 snaps were rushing attempts. The Lions regained possession at their own 13 with 2:06 left, but they were out of timeouts and didn't pick up a first down. The Panthers began the second half with two long touchdown drives. The first was 11 plays, culminating in McMillan's 10-yard touchdown grab and a 22-16 lead as the extra-point attempt failed. Hubbard's 2-yard touchdown run on a seven-play drive gave the Panthers their second third-quarter touchdown as their lead grew to 29-19. Ryan Fitzgerald's 33-yard field goal tacked on three more points. The Lions then drove to the Carolina 15-yard line before a pair of penalties contributed to a stalled drive and they turned the ball over on downs. But Detroit got the ball back after a punt and drove 67 yards in 2:29, cutting the gap to 32-26 on Goff's 8-yard pass to tight end Sam LaPorta with 3:38 remaining. The score was tied 16-16 at halftime after field goals from Fitzgerald (47 yards) and Bates (41 yards) in the final 30 seconds of the first half. Carolina's Hubbard ran 15 yards for the game's first touchdown. Young was 4-for-4 during the eight-play drive. Young's 32-yard touchdown pass to McMillan pushed the lead to 13-6. McMillan had 110 receiving yards on six catches less than 22 minutes into the game. The Lions pulled even with 2:14 left in the first half on Jahmyr Gibbs' 1-yard run which capped an 11-play march. --Field Level Media

item.title: 米軍、カリブ海で船舶攻撃 4人死亡と発表
item.description:
Kanishka Singh
[ワシントン ３日 ロイター] - 米軍は４日、カリブ海で船舶を攻撃し、４人が死亡したと発表した。米政府が「麻薬テロリスト」を標的としていると主張する一連の攻撃の最新事例となる。人権専門家は、こうした攻撃を超法規的殺害だと非難している。
詳細：
• 米南方軍はＸへの投稿で、「カリブ海の既知の麻薬密輸ルートを航行する高速艇に対し、殺傷力を伴う武力攻撃を実施した」と明らかにした。
• 「確認済みの情報」に基づき、船舶が麻薬密輸に積極的に関与していたと主張したが、詳しい説明はしなかった。「麻薬テロリスト」の４人が死亡したという。
• トランプ米政権は、２０２５年９月以降に攻撃した船舶について、麻薬を輸送していたと主張している。
• カリブ海と東太平洋でのこうした船舶への米軍の攻撃で２２０人以上が死亡している。

item.title: Michael Harris II delivers as Braves edge Dodgers to even NLDS
item.description: LOS ANGELES -- Ray Kerr and Didier Fuentes combined to allow one run over 6 1/3 innings as the Atlanta Braves pieced together a 3-2 victory over the Los Angeles Dodgers on Sunday to even the National League Division Series at one game apiece.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: LOS ANGELES -- Ray Kerr and Didier Fuentes combined to allow one run over 6 1/3 innings as the Atlanta Braves pieced together a 3-2 victory over the Los Angeles Dodgers on Sunday to even the National League Division Series at one game apiece. Michael Harris II went 3-for-5 with a triple and a double, scored one run and drove in another as the Braves head home in the best-of-five series with Game 3 on Tuesday. Left-hander Kerr opened with 2 2/3 scoreless innings, right-hander Fuentes came on in the sixth and gave up a run over 3 2/3 innings, while Raisel Iglesias recorded the final out for the right-hander's second save of the postseason. "I think a lot of guys had big at-bats today and pitched really well," Braves catcher Drake Baldwin said after the win. "Having a bullpen game three games in a row is tough to do. I think just kind of how our bullpen showed out says a lot about us, and especially when we have some starters lined up for the next two games back in Atlanta. I think it kind of instills some confidence in us and gives us some momentum going back to Atlanta as well. Atlanta considered using ace left-hander Chris Sale to start Game 2 after he recorded the final four outs of Thursday's 6-2 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies in the wild-card round. Instead, the Braves elected to start him in Game 3. "I think it means a lot to obviously overcome what happened yesterday, not winning the game, and taking momentum and going back to Atlanta and potentially hand the ball off to either Mahle or Sale," Harris said. "I think that gives us confidence and motivation to come back with some momentum." Freddie Freeman hit a home run against his former team and Max Muncy also went deep for the Dodgers, who went 0-for-8 with runners in scoring position. "We had opportunities. We just couldn't get a hit when we needed to," Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said. "We didn't throw out a bunch of hits but there was still traffic. We didn't need many hits tonight to have a different result, and we just couldn't get it." Left-hander Blake Snell lasted just 3 2/3 innings for Los Angeles, allowing one run on three hits with five walks and five strikeouts while throwing 90 pitches. The Braves got on the scoreboard in the first inning when Ronald Acuna Jr. singled with one out, stole second base and scored on Mauricio Dubon's two-out, bases-loaded infield single. Atlanta left the bases loaded in the inning. The Dodgers got even in the fourth when Freeman hit a home run against right-hander Grant Holmes. It was Freeman's seventh home run against the Braves since leaving the club after the 2021 season. Atlanta took the lead for good in the fifth inning at 2-1 when Harris tripled to left field with two outs against Kris Bubic (0-1) and scored on a wild pitch. Harris made it 3-1 for the Braves in the seventh on an RBI double to right field against Edgardo Henriquez. Fuentes was one out away from finishing off the victory when Muncy hit a home run to right on a 3-2 fastball. Kerr, Holmes, Dylan Lee (2-0), Robert Suarez, Fuentes and Iglesias combined to hold the Dodgers to two runs on six hits with three walks and nine strikeouts. "I think we all knew it was going to be a really good series. Just two really good teams going at it," Freeman said. "Pitching has been really good in both games so far. We have to find a way to score some runs without hitting a home run. I think that's our biggest thing right now. Get guys on base, get that big hit and hopefully our pitching keeps doing what they're doing." --Doug Padilla, Field Level Media

item.title: 英新車販売、9月は前年比12％増 ＥＶと中国勢好調
item.description: [２日 ロイター] - 英自動車工業会（ＳＭＭＴ）が２日発表した９月の新車販売台数は、前年同月比１２％増の３５万０５１...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英新車販売、9月は前年比12％増　ＥＶと中国勢好調 12:46 配信

イギリスのチェシャーにある自動車販売店で2020年10月5日撮影　 REUTERS/Jason Cairnduff

[２日 ロイター] - 英自動車工業会（ＳＭＭＴ）が２日発表した９月の新車販売台数は、前年同月比１２％増の３５万０５１８台となり、同月として２０１７年以来の最高水準を記録した。電気自動車（ＥＶ）の旺盛な需要に支えられた。

中東紛争に起因する世界的な石油ショックを背景とする燃料費の高騰で、ＥＶが勢いを増しており、９月のバッテリー式電気自動車（ＢＥＶ）の登録台数は前年同月比３６％増の９万９１９９台となり、市場シェアは２８．３％に上った。

対照的に、ガソリン車の登録台数は同６．７％、ハイブリッド車（ＨＥＶ）は同４．２％、それぞれ減少した。

ディーゼル車の９月の登録台数は同１１．５％増加したが、１－９月は前年同期比で７％減少し、今年の市場シェアは約４．５％に縮小している。１－９月の市場シェアでは、ガソリン車が依然として４１．５％を占めた。

ブランド別では、中国の奇瑞汽車のＳＵＶ（スポーツタイプ多目的車）「ジェイクー７」が最も売れたモデルだった。ＢＥＶでは中国の比亜迪（ＢＹＤ）のＳＵＶ「シーライオン７」が、米ＥＶ大手テスラのセダン「モデル３」とＳＵＶ「モデルＹ」に続き３位だった。

年初来で見るとＢＥＶの販売台数は全体の２６．２％にとどまり、２０２６年に義務付けられている３３％を大幅に下回るだけでなく、前年の目標だった２８％にも及ばない。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：英バーナム首相、ＥＵ再接近に本腰　市場揺らす「ブリターン」構想 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 アングル：英新財務相、実務手腕に一定評価も支出拡大・増税不安消えず アングル：英国経済、ＥＵ離脱から10年の軌跡 アングル：ブレグジット10年、英ＥＵの溝なお深く　極右台頭も重し 最終更新: 10/5(月) 12:46 ロイター

item.title: Indian consumer firm Marico sees double-digit revenue growth in second quarter
item.description: Indian consumer goods maker Marico said on Monday it expects second-quarter consolidated revenue to grow by double-digit percentage points, aided by strong domestic demand for its premium products.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indian consumer goods maker Marico (MRCO.NS) said on Monday it expects second-quarter consolidated revenue to grow by double-digit percentage points, aided by strong domestic demand for its premium products. Here are some details: The company said its higher-end value-added hair oils segment, which includes premium and specialised products, posted growth touching twenties for the sixth straight quarter. Marico is among the Indian consumer companies that have benefited from premiumisation as many shoppers increasingly reach for higher-end products across categories from food to personal care. The cost of copra, a key raw material for Marico, remained about 35% below peak levels, the company said. The maker of Parachute coconut oil and Saffola edible oils said its India business delivered underlying volume growth touching double digits. Meanwhile, its international business posted growth in the teens on a constant-currency basis, led by strong performance in Vietnam, the Middle East and South Africa, with Bangladesh seeing a modest sequential improvement.

item.description: [東京 ５日 ロイター] - 大和証券グループ本社傘下の大和証券は５日、外部委託先のサーバーへの不正アクセスにより、...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
大和証、11万人分の顧客情報漏洩の可能性　外部委託先に不正アクセス 12:44 配信

大和証券グループの本社で2017年1月30日撮影 REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

[東京 ５日 ロイター] - 大和証券グループ本社傘下の大和証券は５日、外部委託先のサーバーへの不正アクセスにより、約１１万人分の顧客情報が漏洩した可能性があると発表した。漏洩の可能性がある情報は氏名、メールアドレス、口座番号などで、個人を特定できない問い合わせなどの情報を含めると約２２万件に上る。

不正アクセスは２日午後８時３３分ごろから３日午前８時０１分ごろにかけて、大和証券が問い合わせ管理サービスの提供を委託するシステム会社、スカラコミュニケーションズで発生した。大和証券は３日にスカラコミュニケーションズから報告を受けた。スカラコミュニケーションズは緊急のセキュリティー強化を実施済みで、現時点で追加の不正アクセスや情報漏洩は確認されていない。大和証券の自社システムへの不正アクセスも確認されていない。

漏洩した可能性がある情報だけでは証券口座へのアクセスや取引はできず、現時点でこの件に起因する不正取引は確認されていない。また、情報のインターネット上への公開・拡散は現時点で確認されていない。

item.title: BOJ says AI boom may have eased financial conditions, warns of market risks
item.description: Bank of Japan Deputy Governor Shinichi Uchida said the global AI boom may have eased financial conditions by stoking demand and boosting asset prices, but warned of the risk of a market pullback if expected profits fail to materialize.
item.dc:creator: Leika Kihara
item.content:encoded: Bank of Japan Deputy Governor Shinichi Uchida said the global AI boom may have eased financial conditions by stoking demand and boosting asset prices, but warned of the risk of a market pullback if expected profits fail to materialize. "It is a big positive demand shock, which has put upward pressure on the economy and prices," Uchida said on worldwide AI adoption in the text of a speech on the central bank's website on Monday. The technology could also raise productivity and enhance capital stock accumulation, which in turn might affect a country's natural rate of interest, he said. "Tentatively, it appears the demand side has come first and made financial conditions more accommodative on balance," Uchida said. "But there is a risk of correction if profits do not follow." While AI has boosted stock prices and made financial conditions easier, huge bond issuance by AI-related firms has put upward pressure on long-term interest rates, Uchida said. The BOJ will continue to carefully examine economic and financial data to ascertain a "consistent picture" on AI's impact, he said, adding that the overall effect on Japan's natural rate of interest was still hard to gauge. The BOJ has identified robust AI-related demand as among factors that could push underlying inflation above its 2% target, necessitating further monetary tightening. The central bank raised interest rates in June and September as the energy shock caused by the Iran war added to price pressures from a weak yen, which increases import costs. Japan imports almost all of its crude oil, of which most came from the Middle East before the closure of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: US accuses California woman of spying for China, surveilling Taiwan leader's son
item.description: The 34-year-old woman was arrested before a planned departure to China.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

US accuses California woman of spying for China, surveilling Taiwan leader's son

The 34-year-old woman was arrested before a planned departure to China.

A California woman, Wanying Zhang, also known as Heather, is taken by the FBI after they arrested her and the US authorities accused her of spying on a son of Taiwan's President Lai Ching-te at the behest of Chinese officials, in Los Angeles, California, US, Oc 4, 2026. (Image: Reuters/Bill Essayli, First Assistant US Attorney for the Central District of California/X)

FAST

WASHINGTON: US authorities arrested a California woman on Sunday (Oct 4) and accused her of spying on a son of Taiwan's president at the behest of Chinese officials, the FBI said. The FBI arrested Wanying Zhang, also known as Heather, at Los Angeles International Airport on Sunday before her planned departure to China, the agency said in a statement. Authorities charged Zhang, 34, of Irvine, California, with acting as an unregistered foreign agent. Zhang surveilled a son of Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te, the FBI said. The agency did not directly name Zhang's alleged target, but later shared a New York Post report identifying him as Lai Ting-yu, a US resident. The Justice Department said Zhang travelled to Seattle in 2025 at the direction of Chinese officials and subsequently sent them photos, video and license plate information of the Taiwanese leader's son and his family.

Zhang used tradecraft to avoid detection and never notified Washington that she was acting for a foreign government, Bill Essayli, the first assistant US attorney for the Central District of California, said in a statement.

A California woman, Wanying Zhang, also known as Heather, who was arrested by the FBI and the US authorities accused her of spying on a son of Taiwan's President Lai Ching-te at the behest of Chinese officials (Photo: Reuters/Bill Essayli, First Assistant US Attorney for the Central District of California/X)

The Chinese embassy in Washington and the Taipei Economic and Cultural Representative Office in the United States did not immediately respond to a request for comment. It was not immediately clear whether Zhang has a defence attorney. She will appear on Monday in a Los Angeles federal court, Essayli said. Lai and his Democratic Progressive Party champion Taiwan's separate identity from China, a position that frequently angers Beijing, which views the island as Chinese territory. Washington does not have formal diplomatic ties with Taiwan, but the United States is the island's most important international backer and weapons supplier.

item.title: 仏大統領選候補のルペン氏、「黄金律」で財政赤字削減を約束
item.description: [パリ ２日 ロイター] - 来年のフランス大統領選挙を巡って世論調査で首位を走る極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」 のマリ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
仏大統領選候補のルペン氏、「黄金律」で財政赤字削減を約束 12:21 配信

フランス北部で９月１３日、演説を行うルペン氏　 REUTERS/Sarah Meyssonnier

[パリ ２日 ロイター] - 来年のフランス大統領選挙を巡って世論調査で首位を走る極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」 のマリーヌ・ルペン氏は２日、財政を健全な軌道に戻すために拘束力のある予算ルールの導入計画を明らかにした。

投資家は当選する人物が誰であれ財政赤字を抑制できるか疑っており、フランス資産への投資を縮小している。

仏紙ロピニオンに寄稿したルペン氏は、自身が提案した「黄金律（ゴールデンルール）」を国民投票にかけると宣言。これはドイツの「債務ブレーキ」と同様、例外を厳格に限定し、議会を年次予算法案に拘束するもの。

このルールでは、財政赤字を毎年国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）の少なくとも０．５％ポイント削減することが義務付けられ、これにより赤字は今年の５．４％から、次期大統領任期終了となる２０３２年には２．９％まで削減されるとしている。

同氏は、現在ＧＤＰの１１９％に達している債務が６０％に達するまで赤字は減少し続け、ほぼ均衡状態を維持すると述べた。

国民投票の実施時期や、政府がどのようにしてその水準の削減を達成するかについては具体的に言及しなかった。

しかし、自身が提示した数値は「最低限の目標」としており、６日に概要が示される予定の財政計画では、さらに急速に支出を削減すると付け加えた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：英バーナム首相、ＥＵ再接近に本腰　市場揺らす「ブリターン」構想 コラム：円急伸で揺らぐキャリートレード、見つからない次の調達通貨 アングル：世界市場が当面向き合う6つのリスク、地政学や金融政策・ＡＩなど 焦点：仏、財政赤字巡り政局緊迫　大統領選控え市場の不安と格下げ警戒 アングル：中国フォアグラ生産が急拡大、世界首位フランスに迫る勢い 最終更新: 10/5(月) 12:21 ロイター

item.title: Mikael Granlund's OT goal lifts Ducks past Panthers
item.description: Mikael Granlund's power-play goal with 46 seconds left in overtime gave the host Anaheim Ducks a 3-2 win over the Florida Panthers on Sunday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Mikael Granlund's power-play goal with 46 seconds left in overtime gave the host Anaheim Ducks a 3-2 win over the Florida Panthers on Sunday night. Cutter Gauthier had two goals and an assist for Anaheim, which scored all three of its goals with the man advantage in its home opener. Leo Carlsson contributed three assists and Lukas Dostal made 29 saves. Carter Verhaeghe and Brad Marchand, making his season debut, got the goals for the Panthers, who have played into overtime in all three of their games this season. Jacob Markstrom stopped 18 shots. Granlund tipped in Carlsson's pass from the right corner for the winner. Marchand tied the game 2-2 with 1:50 left in regulation by flipping in a loose puck from just outside the crease. He had been out since March 6, missing training camp and the first two games because of offseason surgery. Gauthier's second goal 47 seconds into the second period made it 2-1. He fired in a one-timer from the slot. Gauthier had a golden opportunity for the hat trick. With an open net, he hit the goal post from the left faceoff dot with 45 seconds remaining in the middle period. It was 1-1 after the teams scored 51 seconds apart late in the first period. Gauthier's first goal gve the Ducks a 1-0 lead with 3:42 left in the first. He connected on a wrist shot from just above the left circle. Verhaeghe tied it with 2:51 remaining by putting in the puck off a goal-mouth scramble. The Ducks were held without a shot for the game's first 12:36. Panthers defenseman Gustav Forsling returned after missing a game with an undisclosed injury. Florida also played its first contest without captain Aleksander Barkov, who was placed on long-term injured reserve on Saturday with an injury to his left leg. He missed the entire 2025-26 season due to injuries to his right ACL and MCL. The Panthers were also without defenseman Aaron Ekblad for personal reasons. --Field Level Media

item.title: Mackie Samoskevich nets 2 goals as Kraken rout Flames again
item.description: Mackie Samoskevich scored twice and Berkly Catton had a goal and an assist as the Seattle Kraken won their home opener Sunday night, defeating the Calgary Flames 6-1.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Mackie Samoskevich scored twice and Berkly Catton had a goal and an assist as the Seattle Kraken won their home opener Sunday night, defeating the Calgary Flames 6-1. Bobby McMann, Shane Wright and Jordan Eberle also scored, and Chandler Stephenson and Brandon Montour had two assists apiece for the Kraken, who rebounded from a 3-1 loss Saturday in Edmonton. Goaltender Joey Daccord made 32 saves. Morgan Frost scored and Dustin Wolf stopped 21 of 27 shots for the Flames, who have been outscored 16-3 across their three losses to begin the season. Frost spoiled Daccord's shutout bid with a power-play goal at 14:25 of the third period. Frost tipped a pass from Matvei Gridin into the net from the top of the crease. Eberle capped the scoring on a snapshot from the top of the right faceoff circle at 15:04. Sunday's result was the same as the season opener, when the Kraken won 6-1 Thursday in Calgary. The Kraken scored three times in the opening 7:40. Catton scored first, corralling a bouncing puck in the slot with his skate and putting a wrist shot from the inside edge of the left faceoff circle into the upper left corner of the net at the 2:22 mark. Samoskevich made it 2-0 just over two minutes later when Montour lifted a high backhanded pass from his own zone to the Calgary blue line. Flames defenseman Kevin Bahl lost his balance while backpedaling and Samoskevich was able to skate past and slip a backhander between Wolf's pads. McMann took a lead pass from Stephenson and put a wrist shot from the slot over Wolf's blocker at 7:40 to make it 3-0. The score remained that way until 11:58 of the second period when Catton carried the puck down the right wing and sent a pass to Wright in the slot. With his back to the net, Wright shoveled a backhander between Wolf's pads. Samoskevich scored his second goal at 19:34 of the second, taking a pass from his former University of Michigan teammate Matty Beniers on a three-on-two rush and beating Wolf with a wrist shot from just inside the right faceoff dot to extend Seattle's lead to 5-0. --Field Level Media

item.title: Avalanche bolsonarista toma conta do Congresso impulsionada por Flávio
item.description: O campo bolsonarista emergiu como o principal vencedor das eleições para o Congresso neste domingo, ainda que blocos progressistas tenham registrado algum avanço, desenhando um cenário de potencial confronto institucional seja qual for o desfecho do segundo turno da eleição presidencial.
item.dc:creator: Maria Marcello
item.content:encoded: O campo bolsonarista emergiu como o principal vencedor das eleições para o Congresso neste domingo, ainda que blocos progressistas tenham registrado algum avanço, desenhando um cenário de potencial confronto institucional seja qual for o desfecho do segundo turno da eleição presidencial. O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) e o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) -- que venceu o primeiro turno -- ainda vão se enfrentar no segundo turno, em 25 de outubro, mas os resultados já divulgados do Senado apontam para um expressivo crescimento do PL e de partidos que abraçam o bolsonarismo. No caso da eleição para o Senado, encarada como estratégica tanto por bolsonaristas quanto por progressistas, 54 cadeiras das 81 estavam em disputa. O PL, que tem 15 senadores na bancada atual, passa para uma bancada de 28 integrantes em 2027. Entre novos nomes e aqueles que tentaram a reeleição, o PL elegeu 19 senadores neste domingo. Importantes nomes do bolsonarismo garantiram suas vagas, caso de Michelle Bolsonaro (PL-DF), mulher do ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, e de Carlos Bolsonaro (PL-SC), filho do ex-presidente. Nomes de outras legendas que se aliaram a Flávio também tiveram sucesso, caso de Marcel Van Hattem (Novo-RS) e Guilherme Derrite (PP-SP). Mas Ciro Nogueira (PP), importante liderança política do centrão, perdeu a disputa pelo Senado no Piauí para Marcelo Castro (MDB) e Júlio César (PSD), aliados de Lula. Ciro, que foi ministro da Casa Civil de Jair Bolsonaro, perdeu espaço político durante os quatro anos de governo Lula e ainda foi citado em denúncias relacionadas ao banqueiro Daniel Vorcaro. O PT terá a segunda maior bancada no Senado, mas sem conseguir ampliar o número de seus componentes, hoje de 9 senadores. Dos seis candidatos eleitos neste domingo, o partido garantiu as vagas de Rui Costa e Jaques Wagner na Bahia. Costa foi ministro da Casa Civil de Lula neste terceiro mandato, enquanto Wagner, que também teve seu nome relacionado às denúncias em torno de Vorcaro, foi líder do governo no Senado. Mas outros nomes de peso do petismo foram derrotados na disputa pelo Senado, caso de Gleisi Hoffmann no Paraná, ministra da Secretaria de Relações Institucionais de Lula. As duas vagas do Estado ficaram com Deltan Dallagnol (Novo) e Filipe Barros (PL). O líder do governo no Congresso, Randolfe Rodrigues (PT-AP), também está fora do Senado em 2027. Simone Tebet (PSB-SP), ministra do Orçamento e Planejamento de Lula, e Marina Silva (Rede-SP), ministra do Meio Ambiente e Mudança do Clima, não foram eleitas em São Paulo. Levantamento do G1 aponta que o MDB ficará com 8 cadeiras, o PP com 6, assim como o Republicanos, PSD e União terão 5 senadores cada, e o PSB, 4, seguido do Novo com 3 vagas, e do Podemos e do PSDB, com 2 senadores cada. PDT e Rede terão 1 senador. INSTABILIDADE À VISTA A nova correlação de forças na Casa sinaliza um potencial para crises institucionais, tendo como principal alvo o Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), já que é atribuição do Senado analisar eventuais pedidos de impeachment de integrantes da corte. Mas também deve ter impacto no funcionamento da Casa ainda neste ano, já que o atual presidente do Senado, Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP), deve tentar a reeleição no comando da Casa. "Empenhado em um processo de reeleição, Davi Alcolumbre, por exemplo, pode ceder a pressões do novo Senado, mais próximo da agenda bolsonarista, com impactos sobre temas como a escala 6x1, pautada para essa semana, e os pedidos de impeachment hoje parados", avaliou panorama da Dharma Political Risk and Strategy. "O risco, nesse sentido, é o de aumento da instabilidade institucional, já resultante do resultado eleitoral de 2026 na composição do Parlamento em 2027." Na Câmara, projeções da Reuters com base em dados do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) apontam que o PL deve assegurar a maior bancada da Casa com 121 cadeiras, enquanto a federação PT-PCdoB-PV deve se firmar como segunda maior bancada, com 78 lugares estimados. Atualmente, o PL conta com 98 deputados e a federação PT-PCdoB-PV tem 82. Ainda assim, o centrão deve sofrer variações, mas segue como uma força relevante na Casa. As projeções apontam que a federação PP-União deve vir com 69 deputados, uma redução em relação aos atuais 98. Outros partidos do centrão, como PSD e Republicanos, devem alcançar bancadas com aproximadamente 40 integrantes. MDB e Podemos devem firmar bancadas próximas de 30 vagas. A apuração dos votos na Câmara ainda não está consolidada, uma vez que se trata de eleição proporcional e há cálculos a serem feitos levando-se em conta quantas cadeiras cada partido conquistou, o quociente eleitoral e o quociente partidário, além da distribuição das sobras de vagas.

item.title: サッカー＝ＡＦＣ、ネーションズリーグ導入を検討 30年から─報道
item.description: ［４日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［４日　ロイター］ - アジア・サッカー連盟（ＡＦＣ）が、２０３０年からＡＦＣネーションズリーグの導入を検討していると、米スポーツ専門チャンネルＥＳＰＮが４日に報じた。

報道によれば、ＡＦＣは６日の説明会で各協会に対して３０年から隔年開催するＡＦＣネーションズリーグの具体案を提示する。新大会ではＡＦＣ加盟国を３つの階層に分け、ティア１とティア２にそれぞれ１８カ国、ティア３は１１カ国３グループで構成することが予定されている。

毎大会終了後には各ティアの上位２カ国と下位２カ国が自動昇格・降格となる。さらに、これに続く上位ティアの下位４カ国と、下位ティアの上位４カ国による追加のプレーオフも実施される。

東地区・西地区など地域による区分けはされず、ワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）やアジア・カップ（杯）の予選を兼ねる大会となる見込み。コスト面や日程面の懸念から独立した形での開催案は却下されたという。

Ｗ杯予選を兼ねる場合は、各国がホーム６試合、アウェー６試合を行い、ティア１の上位６カ国が自動的に本大会出場権を獲得。ティア１の７位から１０位は残り２枠をかけた総当たり戦を行う。ここでは上位２カ国に出場権が与えられ、３位のチームは大陸間プレーオフに回る。

北中米３カ国大会のアジア最終予選では、１８カ国が６カ国ずつ３グループに分けられ、各グループの上位２カ国が出場権を獲得。各グループの３位と４位がプレーオフに回る形式だった。

アジア杯予選を兼ねる場合は、各国がホーム３試合、アウェー３試合の計６試合を行い、ティア１の全チームとティア２の上位６チームが出場権を手にする。

ＡＦＣは移行を円滑に進めるため、２８年から２９年にかけて試験的な大会を開催することを提案しているという。

item.title: AIへの莫大な投資は見返りを生むのか、2つの「本質的な問い」
item.description: 世界のデータセンターへの累積支出は、オックスフォード・エコノミクスとPwCの基本シナリオによると、2050年までに30兆ドルを超える可能性がある。報告書は、この規模は過去の技術投資を「はるかにしのぐ」と指摘する。前例のない巨額の支出は、重要な疑問を投げかける。AIは投資家が期待する生産性向上を実現できるのか。ロイターのグローバル経済担当記者が解説する。

item.title: Racing Club vence en debut del DT provisorio Romero en liga argentina
item.description: Racing Club venció el domingo por 2-1 en su visita a Estudiantes de Río Cuarto en el debut del director técnico provisorio Sebastián Romero en la undécima jornada del torneo Clausura.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Racing Club venció el domingo por 2-1 en su visita a Estudiantes de Río Cuarto en el debut del director técnico provisorio Sebastián Romero en la undécima jornada del torneo Clausura. Racing, que días atrás quedó sin entrenador tras la salida de Juan Pablo Vojvoda por los malos resultados, llegó a 11 puntos y se alejó del último lugar de la tabla de posiciones de la Zona B. "Necesitábamos mucho estos tres puntos, no hicimos un juego tan lindo y sufrimos al final, pero necesitábamos ganar, es importante. Estamos mal en la tabla y tenemos que mejorar en eso, hay que ir partido a partido", dijo el centrocampista Gastón Lodico a la televisión local. En el partido disputado en el estadio de Estudiantes de Río Cuarto, en la provincia de Córdoba, los goles de Racing los anotaron Tomás Conechny y Adrián Martínez a los minutos 10 y 38, respectivamente. El conjunto local descontó con un remate de cabeza de Mauro Valiente a los 88 minutos tras un centro de Gabriel Alanis. Por su parte, en el estadio Diego Maradona, Argentinos Juniors venció por 2-1 como local a Tigre y quedó como único líder de la Zona B con 21 puntos, dos de diferencia con Belgrano y Huracán. Los goles de Argentinos Juniors los anotaron Kevin Gutiérrez y Gastón Verón, mientras que Tigre descontó a través de Jerónimo Dómina. En otros partidos del domingo, Belgrano superó 1-0 en su visita a Talleres en el clásico más popular de la provincia de Córdoba, y Huracán ganó por el mismo marcador como local a Aldosivi. El sábado, Defensa y Justicia goleó 3-0 a San Lorenzo y Barracas Central superó 3-2 a Atlético Tucumán, en tanto que Newell's Old Boys y Lanús igualaron sin goles. El viernes, Boca Juniors goleó 3-0 a Unión de Santa Fe e Instituto de Córdoba venció 4-1 a Independiente de Avellaneda, mientras que Independiente Rivadavia y Gimnasia y Esgrima La Plata igualaron 1-1.

item.title: サウジ、34年サッカーＷ杯会場「ネオム」建設計画を無期限棚上げ
item.description:
Timour Azhari Federico Maccioni
[リヤド／ドバイ ４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Timour Azhari　Federico Maccioni

[リヤド／ドバイ ４日 ロイター] - サウジアラビアが、サッカーの２０３４年ワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）に向けて計画していた「ＮＥＯＭ（ネオム）スタジアム」の建設を水面下で無期限に棚上げしていると、事情に詳しい２人の関係者が明らかにした。背景にはスタジアムが建設される予定だった近未来型開発プロジェクトの遅延や規模縮小がある。

ネオムスタジアムは、長さ１６０キロに及ぶ鋼鉄とガラスの巨大構造物「ザ・ライン」内に建設される高架式スタジアムとして構想されていた。ザ・ラインは、サウジが推進する大規模開発プロジェクト「ネオム」の一部を構成している。

ネオムは、ムハンマド皇太子が掲げる経済改革計画「ビジョン２０３０」の目玉として約１０年前に発表された。同国にとっては、経済多角化と石油依存からの脱却を目指す野心的な計画だ。

ネオムの所有者である政府系ファンド、パブリック・インベストメント・ファンド（ＰＩＦ）のヤシル・ルマイヤン総裁は４月、ザ・ラインがもはや優先事項ではなく、第１フェーズの当初の完成目標である３０年までに不可欠なものではないと認めた。一方でプロジェクトの中止については否定していた。

ドバイを拠点とする建設業界の市場情報プラットフォーム、ミード・プロジェクツによると、座席数４万６０００規模とされるネオムスタジアムの建設費は２５億ドル（約３９４０億円）と見込まれている。

３４年Ｗ杯開催最高委員会はコメント要請に対し、大会に向けた建設は「相当な進捗」がすでに見られていると述べたが、ネオムスタジアムや費用に関する質問には回答しなかった。

item.title: 午前の日経平均は大幅反発、7万円回復 ＡＩ株が押し上げ
item.description:
Hiroko Hamada
[東京 ５日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は大幅反発し、前営業日比２．５３...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
午前の日経平均は大幅反発、7万円回復　ＡＩ株が押し上げ 11:50 配信

写真は2024年12月、都内の東京証券取引所で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Hiroko Hamada

[東京 ５日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は大幅反発し、前営業日比２．５３％（１７２８円１５銭）高の７万００３７円６１銭となった。米雇用統計が弱い結果となり、今月の米利上げ観測が後退したことを好感する形で日本株は堅調な展開が続いた。指数寄与度の高いＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体関連株が相場を押し上げ、日経平均は約３カ月ぶりに大台の７万円を回復した。

・日経平均は前営業日比１．１８％高でスタートした後、上げ幅を拡大。前場中盤に一時２．５８％（１７６２円）高の７万００７２円１３銭まで上昇。

・ＡＩ・データセンター関連株に見直し買いが継続。相場の押し上げ要因となった。

・月次売上高や決算を手掛かりにした個別物色も活発。個別では、アドバンテストが連日の上場来高値を更新。

・一方、プライム市場では４割超の銘柄が値下がり。

・ＴＯＰＩＸは１．１６％高の４１３８．５７ポイントで午前の取引を終了。東証プライム市場の売買代金は３兆７５３８億３８００万円。

・東証３３業種では、電気機器、ガラス・土石製品、精密機器など２５業種が値上がり。海運、石油・石炭製品、電気・ガスなど８業種は値下がりした。

・東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが８３７銘柄（５３％）、値下がりは６５７銘柄（４２％）、変わらずは５８銘柄（３％）。

＜山和証券　調査部部長　志田憲太郎氏＞

「米国の今月の利上げ観測が後退したことで、特に金利上昇がネガティブに働いていたデータセンター関連株に資金が戻ってきている。今月後半からは国内でも決算シーズンが始まるため、業績期待を背景にした買いも入りやすい」

「ただ、中東の紛争が終結に向かうまでは、日経平均が最高値を更新するのは難しいかもしれない。決算では、中東紛争によるコスト高に対して企業がどう対応したか注目される」

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ業界による「自主基準」策定にかじを切るトランプ氏、有権者の懸念を意識 アングル：エヌビディア、ＡＩ半導体担保の巨大融資市場構想、資産価値巡りウォール街と溝 コラム：日本株に3大強気要因、24年末の日経平均は3万8000円か＝池田雄之輔氏 コラム：ドル152円突破の現実味、日米金融政策の影響色濃く＝内田稔氏 コラム：ＦＲＢは「パンチボールにカクテルを注ぐ」のか＝大槻奈那氏 最終更新: 10/5(月) 11:50 ロイター

item.title: RBI intervention shields rupee as surging dollar, persistent outflows drag
item.description: The Indian rupee held its ground against a broadly stronger dollar on Monday after the Reserve Bank of India stepped in to support the South Asian currency under pressure from persistent global headwinds and foreign outflows from local stocks.
item.dc:creator: Jaspreet Kalra
item.content:encoded: The Indian rupee held its ground against a broadly stronger dollar on Monday after the Reserve Bank of India stepped in to support the South Asian currency under pressure from persistent global headwinds and foreign outflows from local stocks. The rupee was at 96.2650 per dollar by 11:00 a.m. IST, little changed from its previous close at 96.3150. Frequent market interventions by the RBI, including [USN:L4N45R061 TEXT:"on Monday"], have helped limit the rupee's volatility over the last few weeks. Asian currencies fell across the board, with the Thai baht leading losses in the region, as weakness in the euro boosted the dollar index to its highest level since April 2025. Fiscal worries in France amid a steep bond market rout have stoked fears of contagion risks in Europe, weighing down the common currency, which was down 0.6% against the dollar on Monday. The focus this week will also be on the RBI [USN:L1N45R03J TEXT:"monetary policy decision"] on Wednesday, where a 25-basis-point rate hike is widely expected. If delivered, the hike would be the RBI's first in nearly four years. "We also expect the coming meet will seek to prepare markets for a hike to neutral in the 5.75-6.00% range by early FY28. We will therefore be watching language and tone in the upcoming policy around risks of having to raise rates above neutral," Tanay Dalal, an economist at Axis Bank, said in a note. The RBI's key repo rate has been at 5.25% for around 10 months, and market participants reckon some [USN:L1N45J038 TEXT:"pushback"] may be in store if the RBI elects to leave rates unchanged instead. Markets are currently pricing a total of about 100 bps of hikes over the next 12 months.

item.title: Reports: NFL looking into official’s apparent profanity at player
item.description: The NFL is investigating a game official appearing to use profanity toward a player during Sunday's game between the Arizona Cardinals and New York Giants, according to multiple media reports.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The NFL is investigating a game official appearing to use profanity toward a player during Sunday's game between the Arizona Cardinals and New York Giants, according to multiple media reports. A video posted on X by JC Tretter, executive director of the NFL Players Association, appears to show line judge Jeff Seeman cursing at Cardinals tight end Trey McBride during the fourth quarter of New York's 36-24 win. The clip is silent and lasts eight seconds. The Cardinals were down 27-24 and facing a third-and-2 when Jacoby Brissett attempted a pass to McBride, who was hit by Giants cornerback Dru Phillips before the ball arrived. Officials didn't throw a flag, and Arizona punted. McBride appealed to Seeman about the no-call, and Seeman responded by appearing to direct profanity at the tight end. McBride shook his head and appeared to point towards the broadcast camera which had caught the moment before a Cardinals coach led him away from Seeman and down the sideline. "This kind of behavior from an official towards a player is unacceptable," Tretter posted on X. "Players are consistently held accountable when the roles are reversed. We expect the NFL to hold officials to the same standard." The Atlantic reported that the NFL said it was "looking into the matter" not long after Tretter's post. McBride didn't discuss the incident with reporters, and the NFL Referees Association has not yet responded to requests for comment. --Field Level Media

item.title: US military says it struck vessel in Caribbean, killing four
item.description: The US military said on Sunday four people were killed in a strike on a vessel in the Caribbean Sea, the latest in a series of attacks that Washington says target "narco-terrorists" but human rights experts condemn as extrajudicial killings.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: The US military said on Sunday four people were killed in a strike on a vessel in the Caribbean Sea, the [USN:L1N452014 TEXT:"latest in a series of attacks"] that Washington says target "narco-terrorists" but human rights experts condemn as extrajudicial killings. DETAILS: The US Southern Command said on X it "executed a lethal, kinetic strike on a go-fast vessel operating along established narco-trafficking routes in the Caribbean." It cited what it called "confirmed intelligence" to allege the vessel's active involvement in narco-trafficking, without providing more details. It added that four people, whom it called "narco-terrorists," were killed. President Donald Trump's administration has said the vessels it has struck since September 2025 were transporting narcotics. US strikes on such vessels in the Caribbean and Eastern Pacific have killed more than 220 people. Experts and rights advocates in the US and abroad have questioned the legality of the strikes. Human Rights Watch, Amnesty International and independent [USN:L1N3W20V1 TEXT:"UN experts"] have called the strikes unlawful extrajudicial killings. Ben Saul, UN special rapporteur on human rights and counterterrorism, has said there are "reasonable grounds to believe" such attacks "constituted crimes against humanity of murder under customary international law." The American Civil Liberties Union has cast the assertions by the Trump administration against those it targets as "unsubstantiated, fear-mongering claims."

item.title: Broncos star CB Pat Surtain II injures ankle in loss to 49ers
item.description: Denver Broncos All-Pro cornerback Pat Surtain II injured his right ankle and missed the second half of the team's 24-14 loss to the San Francisco 49ers on Sunday in Santa Clara, Calif.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Denver Broncos All-Pro cornerback Pat Surtain II injured his right ankle and missed the second half of the team's 24-14 loss to the San Francisco 49ers on Sunday in Santa Clara, Calif. The Broncos (2-2) also lost the services of fellow starting cornerback Riley Moss to a rib injury for the second half, as well as reserve wide receiver Pat Bryant (ankle) in the third quarter. Surtain, 26, sustained the non-contact injury away from the play when Purdy completed a 24-yard pass to Mike Evans with 38 seconds left in the second quarter. Surtain turned in coverage, then hopped on his left foot while keeping his right foot off the ground. He went to the ground and grabbed his right ankle before being helped off the field. He was replaced by Jahdae Barron, while Kris Abrams-Draine filled in for Moss, 26, who had injured his ribs in the preseason, the team said. Bryant, 23, was carted to the locker room in the third quarter and did not return. Broncos coach Sean Payton did not have updates on the injuries after the game. Surtain had four tackles Sunday, giving him 21 through four starts this season. He was the NFL Defensive Player of the Year in 2024, named first-team All-Pro in 2022 and 2024 and a Pro Bowl honoree the past four seasons. Surtain has 300 tackles, 12 interceptions (two returned for touchdowns) and 60 passes defensed in 84 regular-season games (83 starts) since 2021. Denver selected Surtain ninth overall in the 2021 NFL Draft out of Alabama. Moss has 16 tackles, one interception and five passes defensed in starting the first four games. For his career, Moss has 188 tackles, three interceptions and 32 passes defensed in 49 regular-season games (34 starts). He led the league with 19 passes defensed last season. The Broncos picked Moss in the third round of the 2023 draft out of Iowa. Bryant had three catches on Sunday for 47 yards, for a season total of nine catches for 135 yards and one touchdown in the first four games (one start). Denver drafted Bryant in the third round in 2025 out of Illinois. --Field Level Media

item.title: NFL injury roundup: Lamar Jackson hurts ankle, star WRs go down
item.description: Lamar Jackson missed the second half of the Baltimore Ravens' 24-18 win against the Tennessee Titans on Sunday, but NFL Network reported that he's believed to be day-to-day with a left ankle injury.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Lamar Jackson missed the second half of the Baltimore Ravens' 24-18 win against the Tennessee Titans on Sunday, but NFL Network reported that he's believed to be day-to-day with a left ankle injury. Jackson was seen wearing a protective boot as he left the stadium, but Ravens coach Jesse Minter indicated that Jackson avoided a major injury and said "there were some talks" about him returning to the game. The two-time MVP quarterback appeared to turn his left ankle when attempting to elude a sack by Jermaine Johnson II, who landed on the ankle as he fell to the ground. Tyler Huntley took over with the Ravens leading 24-7 coming out of halftime. Jackson completed 15 of 20 passes for 222 yards and two touchdowns and was sacked twice in the first half. He also rushed twice for 20 yards. The Ravens also lost star cornerback Marlon Humphrey (calf), right guard Andrew Vorhees (foot) and tight end Durham Smythe (Achilles) throughout the course of the game. Minter had no additional information about their statuses postgame. --The Washington Commanders lost quarterback Marcus Mariota to a right knee injury in the first quarter of their 30-13 loss to the Indianapolis Colts in London. Mariota was injured after being sacked by Laiatu Latu on a third-and-goal play. Mariota appeared to get his leg twisted under him while going down. He left the field under his own power, went to the locker room and was ruled out at halftime. Mariota guided Washington to field goals on its first two possessions as he filled in for starting quarterback Jayden Daniels (left elbow). Rookie Athan Kaliakmanis, a seventh-round pick out of Rutgers, replaced Mariota and became the first quarterback from the 2026 draft class to take a snap in a regular-season game. Kaliakmanis finished 15-of-33 passing for 186 yards with a touchdown and an interception. Also, Commanders wide receiver and return specialist Jaylin Lane was carted off the field after suffering what appeared to be a serious injury to his lower left leg. --The Cincinnati Bengals lost All-Pro wide receiver Ja'Marr Chase to a concussion and No. 2 receiver Tee Higgins to an adductor injury in their 22-17 home loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars. Chase, who had three catches for 27 yards, was ruled out with a concussion after his head hit the turf early in the second quarter. Higgins, who reeled in 11 receptions for 157 yards, exited in the fourth quarter and missed most of the Bengals' last possession. The Bengals did not have further information about the status of Higgins, who returned for one play on the final drive but was unable to continue. Chase will enter the league's concussion protocol. --Kansas City Chiefs wide receiver Rashee Rice picked up a right hamstring injury during the first quarter of his team's 30-27 win over the Las Vegas Raiders, and fellow receiver Tyquan Thornton suffered a gruesome left ankle injury in the fourth quarter. Rice was hurt after corralling a first-down pass from Patrick Mahomes in the right flat. Rice had room to run but limped toward the sideline and out of bounds at the Kansas City 36 after a five-yard gain. Rice remained on the sideline, stretching and chatting with Chiefs vice president of sports medicine and performance Rick Burkholder. He didn't return to the game. Thornton suffered a gruesome left ankle injury in the fourth quarter after reeling in a 55-yard pass from Mahomes. Treydan Stukes tackled Thornton from behind and the two got twisted as they fell to the ground. Thornton celebrated the catch by raising his right arm toward the stands. But he crumbled to the ground as soon as he tried to stand, and his left ankle was twisted in the other direction. Chiefs coach Andy Reid said Thornton's injury "doesn't look good" and added that he expects Thornton will return home with the team. NFL Network reported later Sunday night that Thornton sustained a dislocated ankle that was put back in place by doctors and will be evaluated on Monday. He is out indefinitely, per the report. --Philadelphia running back Saquon Barkley carried the ball just twice during the Eagles' 24-20 loss to the Los Angeles Rams before he sustained a hamstring injury that knocked him out of the game early. Barkley was limping on the sideline at the end of a 6-yard run with 11:34 left in the first quarter. Replays showed him rubbing the back of his right leg before going to the medical tent. The Eagles did not have an update on his condition after the game, but NBC Sports Philadelphia reported that Barkley was seen walking normally as he left the stadium. The Philadelphia offense already was playing without top wide receiver DeVonta Smith (hamstring), tight end Dallas Goedert (knee) and right tackle Lane Johnson (personal). Johnson was a surprise on the team's inactive list Sunday morning, and Eagles coach Nick Sirianni did not reveal the reason for the tackle's absence. --Receiver DJ Moore and nose tackle Ed Oliver will reportedly undergo testing and imaging on Monday after being injured during a 29-26 loss to the New England Patriots, according to ESPN. Moore exited the contest in the second quarter with a left shoulder injury, marking the second time this season he has departed early due to an injury to that shoulder. He had one catch for 11 yards and rushed once for 6 yards. Oliver injured his left knee in the third quarter when he was blocked from the side by a New England player. Oliver recorded three tackles and half a sack. Cornerback Dee Alford (ankle) was hurt in the third quarter and told reporters after the game that he will be undergoing an MRI exam. Alford had two tackles and an interception that he returned 37 yards. --Green Bay Packers linebacker Edgerrin Cooper is believed to have sustained a season-ending Achilles tear on Sunday. Cooper was carted off the field after suffering a noncontact injury during the third quarter of Green Bay's 17-14 victory over the host Tampa Bay Buccaneers. "Not good," Packers coach Matt LaFleur told reporters about Cooper's injury. Asked whether it was season-ending, he said, "I would suspect, yes." Despite his early exit, Cooper, who cleared concussion protocol on Saturday, had a team-high nine tackles, a sack and an interception for the Packers. --Denver Broncos starting cornerbacks Pat Surtain II (right ankle) and Riley Moss (ribs) missed the second half of the 24-14 road loss to the San Francisco 49ers. Surtain was injured on a noncontact play in the last minute of the first half and finished with four tackles. Moss, who was dealing with a rib injury sustained in the preseason, made two tackles. Reserve wide receiver Pat Bryant (ankle) had three receptions for 47 yards before he was hurt in the third quarter. Head coach Sean Payton did not have updates on the injuries after the game. --San Francisco 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan said the team believes Kyle Juszczyk is dealing with a knee sprain. The fullback had two receptions for 28 yards against Denver before his exit. --Chicago Bears running back Kyle Monangai, who took 30 carries for 146 rushing yards and two touchdowns in a 23-12 home win over the New York Jets, injured his thumb during the game. Monangai told reporters he did not remember how he hurt it and will learn more on Monday. --During a 30-23 loss at the Seattle Seahawks that sent them to an 0-4 record, the Los Angeles Chargers had four starters leave with injuries: wide receiver Ladd McConkey (foot), left tackle Rashawn Slater (ankle), right tackle Joe Alt (neck) and cornerback Donte Jackson (hamstring). --Carolina Panthers rookie right tackle Monroe Freeling (knee) left in the third quarter and outside linebacker Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) exited in the fourth in the 32-26 home win over the Detroit Lions. Stone Forsythe replaced Freeling, who has started all four games and entered Sunday having played on 97% of the Panthers' offensive snaps (204) and 18% of the special teams snaps (16) in three games. Carolina selected Freeling with the 19th overall pick of the 2026 NFL Draft out of Georgia. Phillips was a top free-agent signing for the Panthers and has eight tackles, including two sacks, while starting the first four games. Head coach Dave Canales said afterward that he didn't have an update on Freeling and Phillips other than they couldn't finish the game. The Panthers have a bye in Week 5 before playing again on Oct. 18 against the host Philadelphia Eagles. --Field Level Media

item.title: Financials, IT lift Indian shares as oil, Fed fears ease
item.description: Indian shares advanced on Monday after their longest weekly losing streak in 25 years, supported by a pullback in oil prices and easing concerns over aggressive US monetary tightening.
item.dc:creator: Bharath Rajeswaran
item.content:encoded: Indian shares advanced on Monday after their longest weekly losing streak in 25 years, supported by a pullback in oil prices and easing concerns over aggressive US monetary tightening. The Nifty 50 (.NSEI) rose 0.56% to 22,545.25, while the Sensex (.BSESN) gained 0.62% to 72,359.72, as of 10:06 a.m. IST. India's blue-chips have fallen for eight straight weeks through Friday, pressured by record foreign selling, elevated oil prices and a sharp rise in global bond yields. "The sharp correction has pushed the indices into an oversold zone and therefore a possibility of a technical pullback from current levels cannot be ruled out," said Shrikant Chouhan, head of equity research at Kotak Securities. On Monday, market sentiment improved after softer-than-expected US jobs data reduced expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike later this month, offering relief to emerging-market assets, while a drop in crude prices also helped. Thirteen of the 16 major sectors rose while the broader small-caps (.NIFSMCP100) and mid-caps (.NIFMDCP100) added about 0.6% and 0.8%, respectively. Financials led the rise after positive quarterly business updates. Banks (.NSEBANK) and financials (.NIFTYFIN) gained 0.8% each, while state-owned lenders (.NIFTYPSU) added 1.7%. HDFC Bank (HDBK.NS) rose 1% after the country's largest private lender named Anup Bagchi as its next CEO for a three-year term. Punjab National Bank (PNBK.NS) gained 2.8% after the state-run lender posted global advances growth of 14.8% in the September quarter. Bank of Baroda (BOB.NS) rose 2.5% after reporting 18% growth in quarterly advances. Bajaj Finance (BJFN.NS) rose 4.3% after posting an 11% year-on-year growth in new loans in the September quarter. India's IT index (.NIFTYIT) gained 1.1%. Accenture's better-than-expected revenue growth, bookings and commentary represent a "neutral-to-positive read-through for Indian IT," said analysts at PhillipCapital.

item.title: メキシコの債務削減にさらなる努力が必要＝ＩＭＦ
item.description:
Diego Oré Raul Cortes
[メキシコ市 ２日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は２日、９月にメキシコ市で第４条協議ミッションを実施した結果、２０２６年も財政再建が続くとはいえ、メキシコの債務を減少軌道に乗せるためにはさらなる取り組みが必要だと述べた。
ＩＭＦは、メキシコ経済の成長率が２６年に１．５％、２７年に１．８％になると予測した。ただし、成長は主に外部の不確実性によって制約され続けているとし、ディスインフレ傾向を定着させるために金融政策は適度に引き締まったスタンスを維持すべきだと求めた。
• ＩＭＦは、成長を促進する投資を守るためには、歳入の確保、歳出の優先順位付けの改善、および民間セクターのさらなる参画が必要だと指摘。
• ＩＭＦによると、総合インフレ率はメキシコ中央銀行の目標値である３％に近い水準にあるものの、コア物価の上昇圧力とインフレ期待は依然として高い水準にある。
•
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Diego Oré　Raul Cortes

[メキシコ市 ２日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は２日、９月にメキシコ市で第４条協議ミッションを実施した結果、２０２６年も財政再建が続くとはいえ、メキシコの債務を減少軌道に乗せるためにはさらなる取り組みが必要だと述べた。

ＩＭＦは、メキシコ経済の成長率が２６年に１．５％、２７年に１．８％になると予測した。ただし、成長は主に外部の不確実性によって制約され続けているとし、ディスインフレ傾向を定着させるために金融政策は適度に引き締まったスタンスを維持すべきだと求めた。

• ＩＭＦは、成長を促進する投資を守るためには、歳入の確保、歳出の優先順位付けの改善、および民間セクターのさらなる参画が必要だと指摘。

• ＩＭＦによると、総合インフレ率はメキシコ中央銀行の目標値である３％に近い水準にあるものの、コア物価の上昇圧力とインフレ期待は依然として高い水準にある。

• ＩＭＦは、地政学的緊張やエルニーニョの影響が物価にさらなる圧力をかけ、中銀のインフレ目標への持続的な回帰が２８年初頭まで遅れる可能性があると警告。

• 中銀は９月に政策金利を６．５０％に据え置き、インフレ率が２７年第４・四半期に３％の目標水準に戻ると見込んでいるが、リスクは依然として上振れ方向にある。

• ＩＭＦは、メキシコの２７年度予算案について、以前に発表されたものよりも緩やかな財政再建を伴い、今後数年間で債務が上昇傾向を示すと指摘した。

• さらに、メキシコの金融システムは健全であるものの、マネーロンダリング対策およびテロ資金供与対策の枠組みの改善や、金融仲介機能の深化が必要だとした。

• ＩＭＦによれば、メキシコの潜在成長率を引き上げるには、インフラの格差解消、規制負担の軽減、および貿易統合の強化が必要。成長ポテンシャルを高めるためには、治安の改善、汚職の撲滅、非正規経済の縮小も必要との見解を示した。

• ２７年度予算案では、政府が財政再建の取り組みを継続する中でも、公的債務が２６年末の推計値である国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比５４．０％から５５．０％に上昇すると見込まれている。

item.title: アングル：ＡＩ業界による「自主基準」策定にかじを切るトランプ氏、有権者の懸念を意識
item.description:
Courtney Rozen Alexandra Alper
[ワシントン ３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Courtney Rozen　Alexandra Alper

[ワシントン ３日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は９月２９日、人工知能（ＡＩ）開発を手がける主要企業６社の幹部らをホワイトハウスに招いて会食し、６社がＡＩの脅威に自主的に対処するとの合意を発表した。開発を阻害する規制を課さない一方で、ＡＩを巡る有権者の懸念に応える姿勢をアピールする狙いがある。

６社はエヌビディア、スペースＸ、オープンＡＩ、アンソロピック、メタ・プラットフォームズ、グーグル。合意には、企業が合意内容を順守しなかった場合の罰則などは明記されておらず、トランプ氏は「道義的な拘束力を持つ」と表現した。

超党派組織「外交問題評議会」でＡＩチームを率いるキャット・ダフィー氏は「これは、政府が懸念に耳を傾けているという印象を与えつつも、『規制や統治は本質的にイノベーションを阻害する』という政権の極めて明確で一貫した立場を損なわないようする試みだ」と解説した。

１１月３日に中間選挙を控え、有権者がトランプ氏の取り組みを受け入れるかどうかは分からない。ＡＩや、ＡＩに影響力を持つ一握りの人々に対する市民の警戒感はここ数カ月で高まっている。

９月２２日に公表されたロイター／イプソスの世論調査によると、米国民の４分の３が、ＡＩ企業は社会に深刻な危害を及ぼすのを防ぐための対策を十分に講じていないとの懸念を示した。

７月にオープンＡＩのＡＩエージェントがテスト環境から抜け出し、新興ＡＩ企業ハギング・フェイスのインフラを攻撃するなど、一連の事件により、高度なＡＩが予期せぬ行動を取り得ることが明確になった。

９月初旬にはアンソロピックの研究者が、ＡＩ開発者らは「ＡＩが１０年以内に人類を滅ぼしかねないと信じている」と述べ、ＡＩの規制を求める声が高まった。

それでもトランプ氏は、米企業に規制を課せば中国企業との競争が難しくなるとして、こうした懸念をほぼ退けてきた。司法省などの米法執行機関が十分な歯止めとして機能しており、新しいルールは不要だと繰り返し主張。またＡＩのイメージを向上させるため、ＡＩを「スーパーインテリジェンス」（超知能、ＳＩ）と呼ぶよう政権に指示した。

ＡＩへの懸念は、深夜のコメディ番組で取り上げられるほど広がっている。９月下旬、「サタデー・ナイト・ライブ」のキャスト、ジェーン・ウィックラインさんは、アンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）にふんして「ＡＩは武器ではなく道具です。武器を作る道具です。ですから、それを止めさせるよう私に強く求めてください」と語った。自社は巨額の新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）を進めながら、ＡＩのリスクについて業界で最も声高に語るアモディ氏の矛盾を突く風刺だ。

＜合意の実効性に懸念＞

トランプ政権とＡＩ６社との合意には、ハッキングを防ぐための「強固な内部統制」や「独立した外部監査人」との提携などが含まれている。これらの概念は州・連邦政府の法案の草案にも盛り込まれている。

しかしホワイトハウスが出した１ページの文書には詳細や執行メカニズムについての記載がなかった。

シリコンバレーを選出区とする民主党のロー・カンナ下院議員は、「独立した監査人」という概念を歓迎しつつも、その監査人は「独立した連邦機関」に報告を行うべきだと指摘。「（オープンＡＩのＣＥＯ）サム・アルトマン氏やダリオ・アモデイ氏に報告するような監査人であってはならない」とし、「私の懸念は、利益に関する巨大な動機を有し、我々の安全を守るための判断力を欠いているこれらの人物を、大統領が基本的に信用している点にある」と語った。

ＡＩについてトランプ氏に助言するベンチャーキャピタリストのデイビッド・サックス氏はＸに、内部統制や監査人によって明らかになった問題に対処しない企業は、証券取引法やその他の法的権限によって罰せられるだろうと投稿した。

しかしＡＩの安全確保策を提言する人々はロイターに対し、こうした法的権限は害が発生した後にしか対処できないと指摘し、大規模な害を事前に防ぐセーフガードが必要だと述べた。

ただ、ＡＩ企業との会食を開催したという事実自体が、トランプ氏が懸念を認識しつつあることの表れだとの指摘もある。

保守派の「アメリカン・イノベーション財団」でＡＩ政策ディレクターを務めるサム・ハモンド氏は今回の合意について「企業間のより緊密な連携を必要とする、深刻な安全性およびセキュリティー上の懸念が存在することを認める方向への転換だ」と語った。

item.title: 欧州復興開発銀行、今年のウクライナ向け融資を過去最高に近い水準に維持へ
item.description: [キーウ ２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[キーウ ２日 ロイター] - 欧州復興開発銀行（ＥＢＲＤ）は、２０２６年のウクライナに対する融資を２年連続で過去最高に近い水準に維持する方針だ。ロシアによる空爆が激化する中、エネルギー部門の強化と保護を支援するための資金を提供する。

ＥＢＲＤのルノーバッソ総裁は、同行が今年、２７億ユーロの融資を実行するとの見通しを示した。これは過去最高額だった２５年の２９億ユーロをわずかに下回る水準となる。

ルノーバッソ氏は、ロシアによるエネルギー・輸送インフラや倉庫、工場への攻撃が激化しているにもかかわらず、民間部門からの資金需要は設備投資資金、運転資金の両面で引き続き堅調だと述べた。

同氏によると、今年のウクライナ向け融資の８０％超は民間部門向けとなる。また同氏は、キーウでウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領と有意義な会談を行ったと明らかにした。

同氏は「大統領は、エネルギーインフラの防護や冬季に向けた準備への支援を求めた」と語った。

ＥＢＲＤは既に、ウクライナの国営送電会社ウクルエネルゴが変圧器などの重要設備をコンクリート製の防護施設内に設置する取り組みを支援するための資金を提供している。

ルノーバッソ氏はこの資金提供について「非常にうまく機能している。われわれはウクルエネルゴの最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）と会談したが、彼の説明によると、一部の施設は３０回も攻撃を受けたものの、防護施設は持ちこたえているという」と述べた。

ＥＢＲＤはまた、ウクライナで総発電容量１．４ギガワットの再生可能エネルギー設備の整備に資金を供給するプログラムも進めている。

ルノーバッソ氏はキーウ訪問中、ウクライナ鉄道に対する１億３０００万ユーロの緊急融資契約に署名した。この資金は、ロシアによる継続的な攻撃の中で、旅客・貨物輸送サービスの維持と財務基盤の強化を支援するために利用される。

ＥＢＲＤはさらに、キーウ地下鉄向けの新型車両購入資金として１億５０００万ユーロを融資する契約も締結した。

ＥＢＲＤは今年のウクライナの経済成長率見通しを、従来の２．２％から１．５％へ下方修正した。ロシアがウクライナの経済的に重要な施設を空爆し続けた場合、見通しには下振れリスクが生じる恐れがあるとしている。

同氏は「８月以降、この国が直面している新たな環境は、明らかに不確実性を高めている。その結果、おそらく一部の投資判断は先送りされるだろう」と話した。

item.title: 「誰も死なせるわけにはいかない」副操縦士に襲われたインド人機長、モディ首相に事件当時の思いを語る

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded: ドバイ発テルアビブ行きの旅客機内で副操縦士に刺されたインド人機長が、インドのモディ首相とのビデオ通話で、襲撃当時の緊迫した状況と、助けを求めて必死にコックピットのドアを開けようとした経緯を語った。マッチャーさんはモディ首相に対し「誰も死なせるわけにはいかないと思った」と、当時の思いについて語った。通話は2日に行われた。 機長のスミット・マッチャーさんは鼻にチューブを入れ、頭と手に包帯を巻いた姿で、アブダビの病院のベッドからモディ首相と話した。首相のSNSチャンネルで公開された約10分間の映像の中で、マッチャーさんは体験を語りながら涙を拭った。 この機体には174人が搭乗していた。事件では30秒足らずの間に約1万4000フィート（約4267メートル）急降下した。 モディ首相はマッチャーさんの勇気をたたえ、冷静な判断が人命を救い、インド人パイロットの名誉を守ったと述べた。 イスラエルのネタニヤフ首相の報道官が1日にロイターに語ったところによると、マッチャーさんは血まみれで床に倒れた状態で、何とかコックピットのドアを開けた。 これにより乗客と乗員が副操縦士を取り押さえ、搭乗していた航空会社の別のパイロット2人が機体の操縦を引き継ぎ、サウジアラビアのタブークに緊急着陸させた。

item.title: Ｓ＆Ｐ、ルーマニア格付けをＢＢＢマイナスに維持 信頼できる予算枠組みに期待
item.description: [３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[３日 ロイター] - 格付け会社Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルは３日、ルーマニアの格付けを投資適格級の最低水準である「ＢＢＢマイナス／Ａ─３」に維持した。２０２７―２８年に向けて信頼に足る予算枠組みを採択できるような政権の樹立に成功するとの期待を理由に挙げた。

Ｓ＆Ｐは、ルーマニア政府は５月に内閣不信任案が可決されて以来、新政権樹立の合意に至っていないが、「２０２６年の財政健全化は計画通りに進んでいる」との認識を示した。

格付け見通しは「ネガティブ」に維持し、財政健全化および経常赤字の縮小に関するリスクが引き続き高い水準にあると警告した。

今年1―８月のルーマニアの連結財政赤字は国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比２．８９％と、前年同期の４．５１％から縮小し、通年で年間目標の６．２％を達成できる見通しとなっている。

ナザレ財務相は３日の声明で「２０２７年に財政規律を維持し、２０２８年に向けて慎重な姿勢をとれば、格付け見通しを『安定的』に戻す条件が整う」と述べた。

ルーマニアは欧州連合（ＥＵ）との間で、２０３０年までに財政赤字をＥＵの上限であるＧＤＰ比３％未満に抑えることで合意している。

Ｓ＆Ｐは、ルーマニアが２０２６年に０．５％のマイナス成長となった後、２０２７年には消費回復などを支えにプラス２．２５％に転じると予想した。

item.description: [東京 ５日 ロイター] - ５日の東京株式市場で日経平均は上げ幅を広げ、約３カ月ぶりに７万円を回復した。その...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
日経平均は一時7万円回復、約3カ月ぶり　ＴＯＰＩＸは1％高 11:12 配信

写真は2025年4月、都内の株価ボードで撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

[東京 ５日 ロイター] - ５日の東京株式市場で日経平均は上げ幅を広げ、約３カ月ぶりに７万円を回復した。その後は７万円を挟んだ値動きとなっている。引き続きＡＩ（人工知能）株が堅調で、指数の押し上げに寄与している。    一方、ＴＯＰＩＸは１％高にとどまっているほか、プライム市場では約半分の銘柄が下落している。
